title: Barium X-ray of the stomach and bowel
what: You drink a white liquid with barium, and the X-ray shows your food pipe, stomach, and bowel. Barium is not absorbed and leaves with your stool.
why: For trouble swallowing, belly pain, or a suspected narrowing, hiatal hernia, or problem with food passing through.
duration: usually 20 to 40 minutes; if the small bowel is checked, images are taken over several hours
tell_doctor: If you are or might be pregnant
If you had stomach or bowel surgery before
Diabetes. Because of fasting, your medicines need adjusting. The doctor will tell you how

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually nothing to eat for 8 to 12 hours before the test, most often from the evening before. Your clinic will give you the exact time.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: A light dinner with no fizzy drinks, beans, cabbage, or dark rye bread.

prepare.title: In the morning
prepare.text: Do not drink, smoke, or chew gum. This affects the images.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Tell your doctor what you take regularly. They will decide what to take in the morning.

bring: Water to drink after the test
steps: You take off jewelry and clothes above the waist and put on a gown
You stand at the X-ray machine
You drink the barium liquid in sips when the doctor tells you
The doctor watches on a screen how it moves and takes images
You are asked to turn, lie down, or hold your breath
If the bowel is checked, images are repeated after some time
feel: The liquid is thick and tastes like chalk
after: Usually you can eat right away
Drink more water for 1 to 2 days. This helps the barium leave faster
Your stool will be pale or white for 1 to 3 days. This is normal
The report is usually ready the same day
red_flags: No bowel movement for more than 2 to 3 days, with a bloated, painful belly
Severe belly pain or vomiting: see a doctor right away or call emergency services

faq.q: Why is my stool white after a barium X-ray?
faq.a: That is the barium leaving your body. It is normal and passes in 1 to 3 days. Drink more water.

faq.q: Is this the same as a barium enema?
faq.a: No. In a barium enema, barium is put in through the rectum to look at the large bowel. The preparation is different.

reminders.text: Barium X-ray tomorrow. Have a light dinner with no fizzy drinks or beans. After dinner, do not eat until the test.
